references.text: Both verses illustrate the biblical theme of the limitations of old age and the transition to death as a decisive moment in God's plan.
Both verses highlight old age as a human obstacle or context for God's actions, and illustrate how faith responds to this (Isaac's misguided intervention versus Zechariah's doubt).
A profound thematic contrast between uncertainty about the time of death (Isaac) and sudden intervention that takes life away in the midst of time (Hezekiah).
A contrasting thematic parallel showing two different human attitudes toward old age and death: uncertainty (Isaac) versus hope for natural completion (Job).
